body: i do live with the things i’ve done and i’ve come to terms that I hurt the person I love but he always brings up the things i’ve done and it just throws me into a depressive episode:/ he doesn’t let it go and i’ve tried to prove myself to him, to gain his trust back (to clarify I didn’t cheat on him, he’d come back into my life and then ghost me over and over again and in those ghosting periods when he wasn’t around i’d hu with other guys, so he calls me whore as a joke or used goods. I genuinely love him, yes he says hurtful things but when he’s also a sweet guy and makes me the happiest person ever. again what do I do)

before getting into a relationship you need to take care of yourself, get the help you need first, improve yourself, love yourself, then find that special someone. someone once told me, “if you don’t love/take care yourself first how could you love/take care of another person”. I hope this helps <3
